```{r}
#| include: false
PSA_Units <- "cm/s2"
# Identities of the tables placed at the end of the summary: knitBlock rewrites every label with its stem (the chapters knit the same builders with their own labels, and a DOCX is one document), and the PGA builder labels its DOCX block separately.
TBL.PGA.TR <- if (knitr::pandoc_to("docx")) "tbl-exec-pga-tr-pga-tr-docx" else "tbl-exec-pga-tr-pga-tr"
TBL.DEQ.PGA <- "tbl-exec-deq-pga-deq-pga"
TBL.MCER <- "tbl-exec-mcer-sites-mcer-sites"
TBL.KH <- "tbl-exec-kh-sites-kh-sites"
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(SelectionTable)) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(SelectionTable))) {
    .knitSelectionBlock(
      path = "/_results/srs.results.qmd",
      stem = "exec-srs-results",
      selections = SelectionTable,
      i = i,
      root = root,
      anchor = "sec-exec-srs-selection",
      context = "SRS executive summary"
    )
  }
  rm(i)
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
Notes <- c(
  .deckNote("sha", "Seismic Hazard Assessment", "The hazard curves, the probabilistic spectra, and the deterministic scenarios are presented in the %s annex."),
  if (!is.null(SelectionTable)) .deckNote("srs", "Seismic Record Selection", "The selected records and their verifications are presented in the %s annex."),
  .deckNote("sdc", "Seismic Design Criteria", "The design criteria and the structural design spectra are presented in the %s annex."),
  .deckNote("gmdp", "Ground-Motion Design Parameters", "The fundamental periods, the Newmark displacements, and the seismic coefficients are presented in the %s annex.")
)
Notes <- Notes[nzchar(Notes)]
if (length(Notes)) cat(paste(Notes, collapse = " "), "\n", sep = "")
rm(Notes)
```
